purpose: Teach: 照らし/記さ/屈し/残留/広範囲/生じる/通念/護衛

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、X線が照らした病巣を医療チーム確認しました
lines.en: Ren — we've confirmed the lesion the X-ray showed. The medical team has reviewed it.
lines.style: Clear, professional opening. Steady eye contact. Measured pace with slight emphasis on 'confirmed'—reassurance through precision, not warmth. Clinical but not cold.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: カルテに記された経過、貴院ご確認されているんですね、先生
lines.en: I see you've gone through the medical history in my chart already, Doctor.
lines.style: Quiet, observant tone. Slight lift at the end—noticing, not accusing. The careful politeness of someone checking his own understanding. Respectful but genuine.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、病状に屈した患者さんに医療チーム寄り添います
lines.en: Yes — when patients are struggling with their illness, our team stays close.
lines.style: Warm but steady. Not rushing the thought. Slight pause before 'stays close' to let the commitment land. Tired shoulders beneath the words but voice remains clear.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 院内に残留した感染、貴院対応されたんですね、先生
lines.en: So the hospital did handle the residual infection that developed. I'm grateful for that.
lines.style: Soft, thoughtful. Processing what was said. The politeness is genuine here, not performative. Slight exhale mid-sentence—relief mixed with the weight of what was needed.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、広範囲の検診を医療チーム実施しました
lines.en: Yes — we ran a comprehensive screening across the board to catch anything else.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, thorough. No pride in it, just fact. Slight tick forward on 'comprehensive'—this was the right call. Voice stays level and professional.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 治療から生じる副作用、貴院、配慮されておられますね、先生
lines.en: You've thought about the side effects that come with treatment, haven't you, Doctor.
lines.style: Slow, careful phrasing. This is a question beneath the statement. Respectful but searching—he's trying to understand how much the doctor has already considered. Gentle, not challenging.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、古い医療通念に医療チーム、とらわれません
lines.en: Yes — we don't let outdated medical thinking constrain our approach here.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Not defensive. The words land with quiet weight. Voice stays low and steady—this is something she believes in. No performance, just truth.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: VIP患者さんの護衛、貴院、ご手配なさったんですね、先生
lines.en: We've arranged for the VIP patient's security detail, of course. That's already taken care of.
lines.style: Efficient, matter-of-fact. Brisk nod beneath the words. Professional assurance—this is handled, move on. Slight warmth at the close, acknowledging Ren's concern was valid.
